_doc: Death causes (scripts/systems/death_causes.gd). More causes: add data/death_causes/NN_<task>.json (same shape, merged by id). Tokens: {name} {cause} {summary}. grief.strength picks the buff (<=1 grieving, <=1.6 grieving_heavy, else grieving_shattered); days = how long family grieves (friends 60 percent, townies you knew 50 percent). child_text is the thought for kids and teens. severity 1-5 feeds the chronicle.

default.label: Unknown
default.child_text: I miss them so much. Why did they have to go?

old_age.label: Old age
old_age.legacy_text: Their long life came to a quiet end.
old_age.child_text: They were very old. I'll miss them, though.

heart_attack.label: Heart attack
heart_attack.text: {name} collapsed suddenly and could not be revived.
heart_attack.legacy_text: Their life ended suddenly with a heart attack.
heart_attack.child_text: They were fine yesterday. I don't understand.

illness.label: Illness
illness.text: {name} lost the fight against a long illness.
illness.legacy_text: Their life ended after a serious illness.
illness.child_text: They were so sick. I wish they were still here.
